name: corner-ao-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `cornerAo` flag (simple tier — present in both Simple and Pro by default). WallSegment.tsx gates a baked wall/floor AO strip mesh (WallFloorAO, scene/CornerAO.tsx) on `cornerAoFlag && cornerAoQuality`; the default `performance` quality tier has `cornerAo: true`, so the strips render out of the box. Since a tier:'simple' flag resolves the SAME in both modes, the three-part proof from the batch-7 gotcha applies: (1) present in Simple, (2) present in Pro, (3) a direct setFeatureFlag override actually removes the meshes and restoring it brings them back — proving the flag controls the effect, not just a mode switch. Probed via the scene graph (window.__three.scene, dev-only) rather than pixels: WallFloorAO renders a `meshBasicMaterial` with `opacity === CORNER_AO_OPACITY` (0.42) and a `PlaneGeometry` on a shared gradient texture, a stable oracle independent of camera framing.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: cornerAo should be ON by default in Simple mode (tier: simple, default: true)

steps.name: verify-quality-tier
steps.failMessage: Default quality tier is not 'performance' (cornerAo strips only render on performance/medium)

steps.name: count-ao-strips-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.type === 'PlaneGeometry' && o.material && Math.abs((o.material.opacity||0) - 0.42) < 0.001 && o.material.transparent) n++; }); window.__aoSimple = n; return n; })()

steps.name: assert-ao-strips-present-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!(window.__aoSimple > 0)) throw new Error('No corner-AO strip meshes found in Simple mode with cornerAo ON (found ' + window.__aoSimple + ')'); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: cornerAo should still be ON in Pro mode (tier:'simple' resolves the same in both modes)

steps.name: count-ao-strips-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.type === 'PlaneGeometry' && o.material && Math.abs((o.material.opacity||0) - 0.42) < 0.001 && o.material.transparent) n++; }); window.__aoPro = n; return n; })()

steps.name: assert-ao-strips-present-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!(window.__aoPro > 0)) throw new Error('No corner-AO strip meshes found in Pro mode'); if (window.__aoPro !== window.__aoSimple) throw new Error('Strip count changed between Simple (' + window.__aoSimple + ') and Pro (' + window.__aoPro + ') just from a mode switch — cornerAo should be unaffected by uiMode'); })()

steps.name: count-ao-strips-off
steps.eval: (function(){ let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.type === 'PlaneGeometry' && o.material && Math.abs((o.material.opacity||0) - 0.42) < 0.001 && o.material.transparent) n++; }); window.__aoOff = n; return n; })()

steps.name: assert-ao-strips-gone
steps.eval: (function(){ if (window.__aoOff !== 0) throw new Error('Corner-AO strips still present (' + window.__aoOff + ') after setFeatureFlag(cornerAo, false)'); })()

steps.name: count-ao-strips-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry && o.geometry.type === 'PlaneGeometry' && o.material && Math.abs((o.material.opacity||0) - 0.42) < 0.001 && o.material.transparent) n++; }); window.__aoRestored = n; return n; })()

steps.name: assert-ao-strips-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!(window.__aoRestored > 0)) throw new Error('Corner-AO strips did not return after restoring the flag to true'); })()
